title: paspalum orbiculare var. cartilagineum
intro: Paspalum orbiculare var. cartilagineum, commonly known as Sea Island paspalum, is a type of warm-season grass native to tropical and subtropical regions. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, promote wound healing, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Sea Island paspalum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. However, further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant, and it should be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
